Maria (CS): Drafting a lightweight SMB-facing runbook we can hand to AEs — focused on low-touch onboarding, predictable perf, and early renewal signals. Posting a short checklist + fallback knobs. feedback pls :slightly_smiling_face:

Devon (SE): love it. can we include a tiny client-side prefill example and a streaming fallback? most SMBs use webhooks and will prefer streaming to cut perceived latency.

Maria (CS): yep. my plan: 1) prefill sample payload; 2) suggested batching limits; 3) streaming + non-stream fallback; 4) renewal signal hooks + short survey capture.

Jenna (PM): add a one-line troubleshooting triage (queue depth, 429s, token limits). AEs love simple heuristics like "if >3 429s in 10m escalate".

Sam (Platform): also include a safe-quantization note and a recommended model shim for cost vs latency (e.g., redwood/gpt-3.5-optimized -> fall back to redwood/gpt-3.5-base).

Maria (CS): copying the draft checklist below — feel free to nudge wording.

Maria (CS): CHECKLIST (SMB low-touch runbook)
- Step 0: preflight (AE asks customer to confirm sample traffic & region).
- Step 1: client-side prefill (send top-k context + user prompt to reduce model tokens). Example payload:```json
{
  "customer_id": "ACME-123",
  "prefill": {
    "user_profile": "plan:startup, locale:en-US"
  },
  "prompt": "Summarize last 3 support tickets for this user"
}
```
- Step 2: batching guardrails (SMB defaults)
  - max_batch_size: 8 requests
  - max_batch_latency_ms: 40
  - per-client concurrency cap: 4
  - reason: keeps p95 latency < 400ms in our small-pool tests
- Step 3: streaming-first behavior
  - prefer streaming on initial interactive endpoints.
  - streaming timeout: 3s to first token, if exceeded, fall back to non-streaming request with `fast_mode=true`.
  - client hint: if network flaky, open a short-poll fallback that retries once after 1s.
- Step 4: KV/prefix cache recommendation
  - cache any static prompt fragments for 24h
  - include cache-hit header in telemetry to correlate cost savings
- Step 5: model routing & cost fallback
  - route to optimized variant. If capacity constrained, route to cheaper quantized variant for non-critical routes.
- Step 6: renewal signals & feedback capture
  - instrument: 3 free success metrics (feature usage, token spend growth, and net success rate).
  - if tokens flat or down for 14 days AND feature usage < 2x baseline -> flag as renewal risk.
  - send in-app 1-question pulse after 7 days: "Was this helpful? (Yes/No)" + one quick text box.
- Step 7: AE handoff & escalation
  - auto-create CS ticket if flagged and AE not active within 48h.

Devon (SE): love the fallbacks. small tweak: streaming timeout 3s -> make it configurable per-client but recommend 3s default. also mention client SDK snippet for fallback:
```js
// pseudo-code: stream-first with fallback
const res = await client.stream({endpoint: '/chat', onFirstTokenTimeout: 3000});
if (!res.receivedFirstToken) {
  // fallback to non-stream mode, set fast_mode to reduce decode cost
  await client.request({endpoint: '/chat', body: {...}, fast_mode: true});
}
```

Jenna (PM): can we add a 1-line survey template and how to surface results to the AE dashboard?

Maria (CS): sure. Survey template: "Was the assistant's answer useful? [Yes] [No] — Optional: what could we improve?". Push results to AE via webhook with event_type: `cs_pulse_response`.

Sam (Platform): ops note — add observability keys: `X-Cache-Hit`, `X-Batch-Size`, `X-Model-Variant`, `X-Stream-Fallback` in logs. This makes postmortems quick.

onboard-bot: Reminder: create doc in /customer-playbooks/smb/light-touch-prefill within 48h :white_check_mark:

Maria (CS): next steps I will: 1) update the internal doc with these snippets, 2) publish a 1-pager for AEs, 3) wire the webhook schema and small survey. tagging @Devon and @Sam for final tech review. Any blockers?

Devon (SE): none from infra POV. I can review the webhook schema tomorrow morning.

Sam (Platform): fine from platform side. will add the log headers to the default tracing template.

Jenna (PM): AE 1-pager: I'll make a 1-slide quick reference (troubleshoot + when to escalate).

Maria (CS): perfect — thanks team. I'll schedule a 20m sync with AEs next Wed to push the doc out. :calendar:

Devon (SE): can we also include a tiny decision tree for "stream vs batch vs non-stream" for AEs? super helpful in call.

Maria (CS): good idea, will add a single-box flowchart. I'll post the doc link when ready.

Devon (SE): quick note — add recommended retry headers: `Retry-After` on 429s, and client should backoff with jitter (base 500ms).

Maria (CS): added. that's it for now, thanks everyone :pray:
